publications.title: HybridSplat: Underwater Dense SLAM via Visual-Acoustic Fusion and Physics-Informed 3D Gaussian Splatting
publications.authors: Song Xia†, Yaming Ou*†, Junfeng Fan, Chao Zhou, Pengju Zhang, Xiaoyan Liu, Xintao Wang, Xiangyu Sun, Zongyuan Shen
publications.venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
publications.alt: Original HybridSplat paper figures: visual-acoustic and physics-informed mapping framework, robotic platform, and Clear and FLSea rendering comparisons
publications.description: Combines DVL-constrained metric tracking with physics-informed 3D Gaussian Splatting to jointly estimate scene geometry and underwater attenuation and backscatter.

publications.title: Event-Based Underwater Structured Light System for High-Speed 3-D Reconstruction
publications.authors: Junfeng Fan, Yilin Jia, Yaming Ou*, Chao Zhou*, Zengguang Hou
publications.alt: Original paper figures of the event-based scanner, reconstruction framework, refraction model, moving objects and wrench reconstructions
publications.description: Combines asynchronous event sensing with a refraction-aware scanning-laser model to reconstruct moving underwater objects at up to 500 Hz.

publications.title: Multimodal Fusion for Underwater Localization Through Hierarchical Uncertainty Awareness
publications.authors: Yuanbo Xue†, Yaming Ou†, Junfeng Fan*, Chao Zhou, Bing Wang*, Chih-Yung Wen
publications.venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
publications.alt: Original UA-AVIP paper figures: hierarchical uncertainty-aware architecture, multimodal robot platform and real-pool localization evaluation
publications.description: Models uncertainty at measurement, module, and system levels to adaptively fuse visual, inertial, acoustic, and pressure information for underwater localization.

publications.title: PL-VAP: A Tightly Coupled Self-Localization Framework for Underwater Robots Using Point-Line Features and Visual-Acoustic-Pressure Sensor Fusion
publications.authors: Yaming Ou, Song Xia, Junfeng Fan*, Chao Zhou, Yupei Huang, Penghang Shuai, Yuanbo Xue, Zengguang Hou
publications.alt: Original PL-VAP paper figures showing the fusion framework, robotic platform, underwater sinkhole experiment and point-line tracking
publications.description: Jointly optimizes point and line features with DVL motion and pressure depth constraints to maintain reliable underwater localization in sparsely textured scenes.

publications.title: Hybrid-VINS: Underwater Tightly Coupled Hybrid Visual Inertial Dense SLAM for AUV
publications.authors: Yaming Ou, Junfeng Fan*, Chao Zhou, Pengju Zhang, Zeng-Guang Hou
publications.alt: Original Hybrid-VINS paper figures: system framework, hybrid vision platform and fusion model, underwater scenes and dense maps
publications.description: Uses active structured-light depth to strengthen passive visual-inertial initialization, feature tracking, and loop closure while producing dense underwater maps.

publications.title: Structured Light-Based Underwater Collision-Free Navigation and Dense Mapping System for Refined Exploration in Unknown Dark Environments
publications.authors: Yaming Ou, Junfeng Fan*, Chao Zhou*, Song Kang, Zhuoliang Zhang, Zeng-Guang Hou, Min Tan
publications.venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics: Systems
publications.alt: Original ROV-Scanner paper figures showing the robot architecture, binocular laser model, collision-free navigation experiment and dense obstacle map
publications.description: Integrates scanning binocular structured light, multirate sensor fusion, and air-water extrinsic calibration to enable simultaneous obstacle avoidance and dense mapping in dark water.

publications.title: Water-MBSL: Underwater Movable Binocular Structured Light-Based High-Precision Dense Reconstruction Framework
publications.authors: Yaming Ou, Junfeng Fan*, Chao Zhou*, Long Cheng, Min Tan
publications.alt: Original Water-MBSL paper figures: reconstruction framework, mobile scanning platform, moving reconstruction and ship-oar and pipe experiments
publications.description: Compensates scan distortion using inertial measurements and a velocity model, then registers point clouds to reconstruct dense underwater geometry while the robot moves.

publications.title: Structured Light Vision Based Pipeline Tracking and 3D Reconstruction Method for Underwater Vehicle
publications.authors: Junfeng Fan, Yaming Ou*, Xuan Li*, Chao Zhou, Zengguang Hou
publications.alt: Original pipeline paper figures: underwater vehicle, dual-line laser tracking model, SLV sensor, tracking sequence and curved-pipeline reconstruction
publications.description: Recovers lateral, height, and heading offsets from dual laser stripes, enabling closed-loop pipeline tracking and DVL-assisted dense 3D reconstruction.

publications.title: Binocular Structured Light 3-D Reconstruction System for Low-Light Underwater Environments: Design, Modeling, and Laser-Based Calibration
publications.authors: Yaming Ou, Junfeng Fan*, Chao Zhou, Shifei Tian, Long Cheng, Min Tan
publications.venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
publications.alt: Original binocular structured-light paper figures showing the scanner, refraction and calibration models and starfish reconstructions at different turbidities
publications.description: Combines refraction-aware binocular geometry with laser-constrained calibration to obtain precise underwater 3D reconstructions when conventional checkerboard calibration fails in low light.
